URL: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/pm-from-today-britain-will-value-the-hard-hat-as-much-as-the-graduation-cap

Publication date: 27 July 2026 (announcement formally unveiled Tuesday 28 July 2026 per ITV News).

PM press release. Andy Burnham (Prime Minister) announcement to tackle youth unemployment:
- From age 14 (Year 10), students can combine core academic subjects (English, maths, science) with high-quality technical education linked to local jobs.
- New prestigious technical pathways to launch from September 2028, developed with mayors, local leaders, schools, colleges and employers.
- Over 1 million young people currently not in education, employment or training (NEET).
- £570 million existing investment for additional college places.
- £4.7 billion schools funding increase by 2028-29.
- £3.7 billion for 60,000 specialist SEND places.
- Target: 50,000 additional youth apprenticeships.
- Notes a 40% decline in apprenticeships over the past decade (to be reversed).
- 14,000 young people consulted through a national conversation.

VERBATIM QUOTES:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham:
"From today, Britain will value the hard hat every bit as much as the graduation cap."
"Whether you choose construction, coding or classics, or maths, manufacturing or mechanics, you'll get the skills you need."

Education Secretary Lucy Powell:
"Every young person should be able to see a route to success, whatever their talents or ambitions."
